name: robots/chauncygu__safe-multi-agent-robosuite
title: Safe Multi-Agent Robosuite Baxter bimanual arm (MuJoCo model)
intro: Safe Multi-Agent Robosuite Baxter bimanual arm (MuJoCo model), adapted from chauncygu/safe-multi-agent-robosuite. It reads `time_ms`, `qpos`, `qvel`, `ctrl` and 4 more; runs `step` and `reset`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
